verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference. It covers managing workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions programmatically, and named API tokens or personal API keys support headless authentication. The probe's 404s on common OpenAPI file paths do not contradict the claimed reference at docs.jitsu.com/api, so this is not a dispute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Management API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec confirmed at a reachable URL (the probe found none at standard paths).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
